text: It was a Sunday afternoon during UVA Parents weekend. The restraunt was busy. We waited more than an hour for our burgers. The sweet potato fries were limp. The table was dirty. The restroom was very dirty and the door was wrecked at the top. No, I don't ever want to go back!
Worst service ever

Good Game atmosphere. Always been cool. Great to come back to as an Alumni

The food is good but it's 100 degrees and the windows are open so it's hot as hell in here & flies are everywhere. Not to mention the booth they put us at was dirty, the booth seat was even dusty. And our waitress kept running off leaving us waiting for refills & our check.

Unwelcoming and dirty bar esthetic. Jameson tasted watered down. Paid and left after staff sitting there acting like patrons
Victor, the bouncer was fantastic
Really good burger. Food came out quick. Hazy IPA was cold and tastee

Great place all around the board!! All the staff were very helpful to me as im disabled in a wheelchair!! Every employee from the bouncers to the bartenders were very kind and helpful to me! Thanks so very for a great time and a great experience that won't be forgotten!
Honestly the best experience. Excellent service, Alice Agafonova is such a great server, will def be coming back
Kind and respectful service
We used to go to Boylan Heights a lot when I was a medstudent at UVa ( 2013-17). Nothing has lived up to it in the past decade!
Great bartenders.  Recommend the burgers and I ordered wings too.  Everything tasted really good.

This is a great place for college students. But not so much 40 year olds. Haha.

Would recommend for younger customers.

Miserable experience. Was with friends upstairs and we were consistently ignored for 20-30 minutes by the bartenders as they were greeting their friends. The tall male bartender with the black hair and black beard even was welcoming his friends behind the bar and taking shots with them as numerous patrons were attempting to order drinks. I’m fairly sure this is not legal and I will be contacting ABC. Will never be returning here and will absolutely encourage all of my friends to never come to this joke of an establishment.

Bartenders upstairs were horrible. Waited close to 15-20 minutes multiple times to get a drink as the bartenders would pass me up for their friends that would come up to the bar. The bartenders would also take rounds of shots with those friends instead of tending to customers which is illegal. Will not be returning.
Pricey buy great burgers
Great place to meet up with a group.

It's a sports bar... Food is great pub grub. Well done and served fast even when super busy (UVA parents weekend). Our server was covering the entire 2nd floor and did a great job. Management jumped to help. A lot of TVs with all the games. Fun vibes.
Visited Charlottesville and needed a place to watch my beloved Buckeyes. Boyan Heights delivered. Cold beer, tasty wings and nachos, and superb service.
Great bowls, reasonable drink prices.

Walking around campus as students were coming back to school we decided to check out the burgers at this place.

There are 2 floors with the downstairs open for lunch. The burgers were ok. I don't think they were anything amazing. There were only 2 people waiting on tables and staff had to run up to the kitchen (2nd floor) to get food. The meal took a long time as they were short-staffed.
They were so sweet and made a situation that wasn't their fault so amazing. Customer service was 10/10 and food is amazing.
Good wings
Great food and service. We loved our burgers. The sweet potato fries with sugar & honey are amazing!
Best tatter tots around!!!
Entertaining and vibrant environment

It was our first time having lunch at Boylan Heights with the family, and we really enjoyed it. We loved the open-air atmosphere — it was so nice to enjoy a meal while feeling the breeze and watching a basketball game on TV.

The kids were especially excited to see a train go by — that was a fun and unexpected highlight for them!

One small thing: The vegetarian burger I had that day was a bit dry and harder than what I’ve had elsewhere. I’m not sure if that’s how it’s usually served, but it didn’t affect our overall great experience.

We’ll definitely be back again!

Drinks are expensive, service leaves alot to be desired. Very short and to the point service no small talk so if thats your thing maybe better for you. Not for me but not inherently a bad place. Different strokes for different folks.

Boylan is a go to for a recruitment event I plan for the past three years. Two weeks in March I bring 60+ students and candidates to Boylan for a lunch. Boylan delivers every time! Great food, quickly brought out. The staff is amazing, especially Hannah in Sales and Kirstin as Captain. Boylan has been able to work with the different food limitations of our guests and the quality is excellent each time for all who attend. I highly recommend!
I got extremely bad food poisoning from a burger here, do not recommend

The food here is excellent! The serving sizes are generous, the price is decent, and the flavor is great! I was in the hospital with my husband for weeks and made many trips to grab burgers, salads, and their fantastic mozzarella sticks. The staff was always helpful and courteous. Definitely give them a try, you won't regret it!

Completely empty at 9:30, the whole staff is sitting at the bar, ID is when we come in. We sat down and waited for over 10-15 minutes and no one came over to use meanwhile they’re all drinking at the bar giving us dirty looks. Would not return
I was told by the bar staff to not order their food due to low quality. I attempted to bring food from another establishment inside and was asked to leave.
Burger was good! Shake was melted and runny. Overall we enjoyed it.

Horrible place, staff doesn’t care at all. Horrible service I had to go to the bar to pay my food bill because the servers are too busy looking at their phones in the back. Food is pretty gross, won’t be coming back.

Staff was terrific, attentive, and thoughtful.  Five of us had various salads and burgers and all of it was great.  Excellent selection of beer.  We didn't get the truffle fries this time, but that's a definite "should-get" item
Forgot to mention medium rare on the Burger.  The house dry rub wings were great.

Chicken was moist and flavorful with a light and crispy breading. I had the BOMB or burger of the month, called Kickin’ Chicken, which is fried chicken on a brioche roll topped with Cole slaw and aioli with hot sauce on the side. My wife had the loaded nachos, which were very good. They made a grill cheese sandwich on good bread for my son. It was terrific—he ate both halves. A bit noisy so we ate outside.

Came down to watch a late basketball game. Expect the game to end at 12:30am. Kicked out halfway through the 4th quarter because they want to close up. Update your hours if you won't be open until 2am as advertised. I'll find somewhere else to spend too much on mediocre food and drinks.

Never again.
College bar cold drinks fun place great staff a staple for gameday weekend

Typical college bar. Fair number of taps available, some big screens for games, burgers and wings are pretty good, salads are huge, and the wait staff is phenomenal. Very friendly, attentive and helpful.
A happening college spot with excellent service and good food.!
Great bar
Food was nothing special. Pitchers of beer were half off, and thank goodness because they are wayyyyy over priced. Bunch of college kids serving and vaping while they do it.
Great burgers and atmosphere.
Great service, atmosphere, and delicious food!
Great college bar. Perfect for after UVa games or dancing fun on the weekends
Service good burger bad

This was my favorite bar in college but my family got treated like absolute garbage when we visited for a football game. We sat at a table that had no marking whatsoever about being reserved. 20 minutes later we were ejected from the table and were told that our complaints weren’t valid because “ma’am this is a college bar.” A bouncer subsequently tried to kick us out for asking for a better explanation. He stated “you were mean to my server.” This was a lie. She was awful to us. They were extremely rude for no reason. The manager (upon request) did help us get another table downstairs but to have 30-60 year olds treated like criminals to have tried to have a nice time in a “college bar” and be treated in this way was awful. I will not return.

I stopped by with my buddy for a quick lunch yesterday around noon. The burger and tots were outstanding; both were large portions and very well made and presented. The woman working the bar was really nice and that added to a relaxing experience. Thanks!

Food is mid tier at best. But the worst thing about it is the service. Our waitress didn’t even bring us water or check in on us the whole time. And they have a system where they can’t change items on a check even if you didn’t order something? What a joke. Why does this place have 4 stars?
The service was extremely slow, the burgers tasted awful. The only good thing was the curly fries.

Ordered the Meating Canceled and was afraid they accidentally served me a beef patty. Turns out they actually just have really high quality impossible patties. The wait staff was super cool about it, and the burger was incredible.
A very good restaurant/club. Excellent staff and food.
Went for quick dinner near our hotel. The place is pretty run down like a college bar but the staff was super friendly and the burgers were good.
I had a burger craving and I was not disappointed! The burger was juicy, tasty and cheesy. The fries were amazing. Great shakes, too. Service was good also.
Quick service, good spot for a game

I came here for a quick bite and drink to sit out and enjoy the sun. The waitress was very nice. Beer selection was a decent mix of a few locals and commercial beers. Wings were good and so were the "Afternoon Special" chicken bites.

Easily my top 5 best burger in my life. I got the double trouble with the house made bacon jam. Absolutely amazing. Hand pattied real burger
Only had the food here so far. I liked how the burger was hearty and juicy. The sweet potato fries were a little too soft. Boylan has sporty vibes.and very spacious inside.

I think the pandemic has touched Boylan a little. I remember loving it last time I went. This time was just alright. Everything was just slightly off. Nothing worth complaining about, just nothing worth coming back for either.
121 burger for lunch was awesome and reasonably priced.
Great as usual.

Highly recommend their speciality burgers but if thats not your thing you can make your own as well. Will definitely dine here again.

Came for drinks & a bite to eat following a UVA football game. We had a party of 9. The place was packed & the kitchen got backed up & couldn't keep up with more incoming food orders. It took a while before the kitchen could reopen but our server, Lilly, did an awesome job keeping us apprised on the progress of it reopening. The food was worth the wait & our server kept up with refreshing our many pitchers in the meantime. All of the staff we encountered from the young man working the door to our server & food runners had great attitudes & were obviously working extremely hard. I want to especially commend our server, Lilly, as she did an outstanding job!
I love the free shots in the bathroom

Delicious food and excellent service.

I have never had a worse dining experience in my entire life. I placed an online order for pick up and instead of being able to walk in, pay for my order and leave, I was verbally harassed by one of the male employees who was trying to antagonize a fight with me because I ignored him and his friends. Let me also take this second to say I was born with birth defects in both of my arms, and from a person with a disability I was humiliated from the moment I entered the door. Being on a date and being late I wanted the food I ordered. I could have easily left but felt I would have been assaulted if I did. I will never return and will be glad to tell everyone I know to avoid this place.

-A tip to the owners;

Not only should you provide better customer service training to your staff, you should also consider helping your employees with their low self esteem and lack of care for their well-being. I am not a violent person but the world today is full of them and you should have more respect for people and how you approach them. There is no reason for someone to end up losing everything over a bruised ego. I would like to wish your restaurant the very best of luck but feel a few changes are paramount.

Great meaty burgers, but I prefer Riverside lunch overall for Cville burgers. Had a Room 121 w double beef. Beef ever so slightly dry and/or overcooked for my liking but still great. Curly fries delicious. Huge serving. A few beers and watched the NBA east finals game 1. Waitress was very attentive and friendly. A few times they forgot to put the sound on and had music on instead - i like the idea of putting on music during ad breaks though. Massive big screen and a number of other standard screens.  Great college vibe.

Good, classic burgers. Also the appetizers are great - we had the nachos. The wait staff is friendly. If you just want lunch I would recommend going for lunch when it is less busy as it turns into more of a bar at night.
What's not to love? Go Hoos!
Great food!

Keep in mind, we were only a party of 2 people and the first in line. Anyways, he comes back outside, looking like he was about to give us a table but then his "buddies" rounded the corner and suddenly our table was gone and given to them and we were told it would be a 45 minute wait.

Overall experience was awesome. We tried wahoo for our drinks. Room 121 for our burgers. Curly fries were awesome too. The servers were very friendly and overall distanced tables and the fact that they opened all the walls to ventilate the area was also a plus. During this pandemic I recommend this place because they are doing what they can to keep the people and the area safe. I loved the fact that hand sanitizers were placed in middle so you can always use it. Thank you also Aimee for making awesome experience =)

Food was great, terrible service. Our waitress checked on us literally one time, we never  received silverware or napkins. Also was charged extra for ranch and bbq sauce which my group did not ask for. Would never eat here again.
Fun place with good burgers.

I wavered between 3 and 4 stars, so in the interest of the college theme, I will round up and give them a 4 WITH a disclaimer.
This place is what it is: a bar for college kids to get plastered before stumbling back to campus, or the last stop after a bar crawl to try and soak up the booze before calling it a night.
On Saturdays, it may also be a place to go watch the Cavaliers get beat up on by Virginia Tech and/or Florida St.
In either of those cases, you probably are not TASTING your food, so billing yourself a “gourmet burger bar” is a bit pretentious. This place is a dive bar, through and through, and they should enbrace that. Being a dive bar is NOT a bad thing. The food is priced right, of slightly above-average quality, and (on the Saturday night that I went) the service was friendly, energetic, and attentive. A mad dash of coeds rush from table to booth, and even through the face coverings, you can tell it is done with a smile.
Only other note here is that the beers on tap are lacking (there were only three when I went). However, that may be due to COVID.
Burgers are great—not just beef but veggie + other alternatives too!
Sandwiches were great.  This middle aged man could use a glass for his beer rather than a plastic cup.  Definitely a spot to go when restaurants are open.
Molly was so good she even changed the tv so I could watch the game. It was very cool and the food was top notch not kidding. ❤💚💜

The impossible burger gets overcooked and isn't worth the price. I've had the burger at a lot of places, most in Charlottesville don't come near to the creative creations restaurants in other cities make with the burger. Just get it at burger king, it's actually kind of better there.

I came to Boylan yesterday before the football game with my dad and brother. One of us got a cheeseburger and we were charged 75 cents each to add lettuce and raw onions. Have to laugh at the idea that a normal cheeseburger ended up costing the same as the western civ.
